name: Banh uot Hoai Nhon
summary: Steamed rice sheets stacked in layers. Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định addresses them to thị xã Hoài Nhơn and, in the prose, to huyện Hoài Nhơn. Both stay.
origin: Hoài Nhơn. The header says thị xã. The prose says huyện.
howToEat: Roll a piece, cut it, add a little oil and fried scallion, and dip it in sweet-sour fish sauce.
Or eat the sheets with grilled pork, bean sprouts, herbs, and a few slices of green mango.
The hour is Check on arrival.
where: Hoài Nhơn. The portal does not name a Quy Nhon street.
seoTitle: Banh uot — steamed sheets in Hoai Nhon
seoDescription: Bánh ướt Hoài Nhơn is thin rice sheets, with sweet-sour fish sauce or with grilled pork, herbs, and green mango. The header says thị xã and the prose says huyện. Check on arrival.
